findings.title: React import missing in motion.js
findings.description: The useMotionPrefs() function uses React.useState() and React.useEffect() but motion.js doesn't import React. Will cause runtime error.
findings.fix: Add 'import React from "react";' at the top of motion.js

findings.title: Unverified assumption: AnimatePresence from motion package
findings.description: Design assumes motion package exports AnimatePresence, but it does not. Motion uses key-based presence via initial={false}. This is a fundamental API mismatch with Framer Motion v5+.
findings.fix: Either (A) use motion's key-based presence API or (B) revert to Framer Motion. Requires decision and API rewrite.

findings.title: List batching/queuing mechanism completely unspecified
findings.description: Design says 'cap to 5 simultaneous, queue remaining' but provides no algorithm, state structure, timing, or queue-flush trigger. Implementer must guess.
findings.fix: Define batching pseudocode: (1) batch size, (2) flush timeout, (3) queue data structure, (4) append logic during batch, (5) cleanup on unmount

findings.title: RiskGauge counter animation implementation undefined
findings.description: Design suggests 'motion.div + animate({textContent})' which motion doesn't support. References undefined '<AnimatedCounter>' component. No implementation approach provided.
findings.fix: Choose and document approach: (A) useSpring + useTransform to animate number, or (B) external library like react-countup. Add to motion.js helpers.

findings.title: Contradictory and incomplete exit animation timings
findings.description: Page exit is both '0.2s' and '60% of enter (0.204s)'; row exits poorly defined; tooltip exits never defined. Ambiguous whether list collapse happens before or during row exit.
findings.fix: Create single unified exit timing rule in motion.js: define page exit, row exit, tooltip exit, and modal exit durations explicitly. Clarify collapse timing.

findings.title: CSS cleanup list incomplete and unverified
findings.description: Design lists ~12 keyframes to remove but grep shows 60+ animation/transition rules across 4+ CSS files. Missing: 50+ transition rules, iosShimmer, iosPulseSubtle, all 'transition: all' conversions.
findings.fix: Audit all CSS files systematically. Provide exact file:line:selector for every animation/transition rule to remove. Ensure list covers ios-motion.css, CustomSelect.css, csvAnalytics.css.

findings.title: Live component inventory incomplete
findings.description: Codebase has 13 files in live/ but design documents only 3. Missing: AddLabModal, AssignLabModal, LabComputersView, Header, LiveAlertModal, LiveAlertsView, LiveDashboardView, LiveGroupDetailsModal, LiveGroupedDimensionsView.
findings.fix: Expand inventory to list all 13 live components. Assign motion needs: modals → sheet spring, views → pageTransition, lists → AnimatePresence layout.

findings.title: WhileInView scroll margin unit ambiguous
findings.description: Design specifies 'viewport={{ margin: -40 }}' but doesn't clarify if -40 means pixels, percentage, or CSS margin syntax. Motion expects pixels or string with unit.
findings.fix: Clarify to 'viewport={{ margin: "-40px" }}' (pixels). Add scrollRevealConfig constant to motion.js to ensure consistency.

findings.title: Status badge breathing glow infinite loop contradicts motion rules
findings.description: Design specifies infinite breathing loop but Step 3 says 'avoid infinite loops'. Alert pulse is correctly one-time; status badge should match or clarify context (idle vs active).
findings.fix: Either change to finite loop or clarify that status badge breathing is allowed as exception. Document rationale in motion.js comment.

findings.title: Clock tabular-nums font feature not verified with Inter
findings.description: Design specifies 'font-feature-settings: tnum' to prevent clock layout shift, but Inter doesn't support tnum by default. May not work as intended.
findings.fix: Test clock digit updates on Inter font. If tnum unsupported, either use monospace font or accept minor layout shift. Document finding.

findings.title: Motion package React 19 compatibility not verified
findings.description: Design claims motion is 'React 19 compatible' but no version constraint specified. Motion latest may not support React 19 RC/stable.
findings.fix: Test 'npm install motion && npm run build'. If fails, specify exact motion version or revert to Framer Motion. Document version in motion.js.

findings.title: useMotionConfig hook exported but never referenced
findings.description: useMotionConfig() function defined and exported in motion.js but no component shown using it. useMotionPrefs() is active. Potential dead code or incomplete design.
findings.fix: Either remove useMotionConfig() or clarify its use case. If intended as primary hook, refactor components to use it consistently instead of direct spring/variant imports.
